subject: reasoning
question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following number series? 

12, 18, 21, 27, 30, ?
solution:
Considering the above series:

12, 18, 21, 27, 30, ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4feeb3b53a00d101d1d6424cbb5551335bc70775d639518121c3271e35ed641.png] 

The logic of the series can be explained as,

 
• 12 + **6** = 18
 
• 18 + **3** = 21
 
• 21 + **6** = 27
 
• 27 + **3** = 30

By observing the pattern, we can write,

 
• 30 + **6** = 36 

∴ The value of **?** is **36**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"36".**
